text:
Sakshi Tanwar Net Worth: Wealth Enough To Last Six Generations, Said Her Co-Star
Curated By :
Last Updated:
Sakshi Tanwar built an empire not through grandeur but grit, saving every rupee, crafting quiet wealth, and proving that discipline can outshine fame or marriage
1/9
The world of films and television is one where a handful of opportunities can secure a lifetime of financial stability. Among those who’ve turned such chances into lasting success is an actress who once dreamt of becoming an IAS officer but instead found herself under the bright lights of the small screen. Today, she stands as a star who has built a solid fortune from both television and cinema.
2/9
Recently, one of her co-stars revealed that she has amassed enough wealth to sustain six generations, a statement that surprised many. At 52, the beloved star continues to defy age with her youthful charm. Actress Sakshi Tanwar remains a radiant presence in hit serials such as Kahaani Ghar Ghar Ki and Balika Vadhu.
ADVERTISEMENT
3/9
For years, Sakshi was synonymous with family dramas revolving around love, marriage, and domestic conflict. Her popularity even transcended linguistic boundaries when the dubbed versions of her Hindi serials gained a devoted Tamil audience.
4/9
Born in 1973 in Rajasthan, Sakshi Tanwar is the daughter of a retired CBI officer. A bright student, she once aspired to join the civil services, a dream she shared with her father. Determined to make him proud, she worked diligently towards that goal. But destiny had other plans. In 1998, at the invitation of a friend, Sakshi attended an audition for a Doordarshan programme, an event that would alter the course of her life.
ADVERTISEMENT
5/9
She began her career as a television presenter, never having initially intended to pursue acting. Yet, with time, her innate talent for performance emerged. Her breakthrough came with the serial Kahaani Ghar Ghar Ki, where she portrayed a devoted daughter-in-law who held her family together. The show ran successfully for eight years, cementing Sakshi as a household name and a favourite among family audiences.
6/9
Her talent soon transcended television. Sakshi Tanwar earned widespread recognition for her portrayal of Aamir Khan’s wife in Dangal, one of Indian cinema’s highest-grossing films.
ADVERTISEMENT
7/9
Now 52, Sakshi Tanwar remains unmarried but has embraced motherhood wholeheartedly. In 2018, she welcomed a baby girl into her life and has since been raising her daughter with quiet grace.
8/9
Despite her success, Sakshi Tanwar is known for her simplicity and financial discipline. Her co-star Ram Kapoor once remarked that she has saved enough wealth to support six generations, a testament to her prudence. Sakshi is known to avoid extravagant spending and luxury indulgences, preferring to use her savings wisely and only for essentials. She is, as Ram Kapoor noted, “an example of how to spend money wisely in the long run.”
